pages.title: Frostmane Hollow
pages.intro:
Turtle-custom level 13-20 5-man in eastern Dun Morogh, just south of the Ironforge Airfields. Added in 1.18.1. It is the Frostmane trolls' sanctum and the lowest-level custom dungeon ([wiki](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Frostmane_Hollow)).

| | |
|---|---|
| Level / size | 13-20, 5 players ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)) |
| Location | Eastern Dun Morogh |
| Added | 1.18.1 (opened 2026-03-20) |
| Entry | None found |
| Bosses | 4-5 wiki pages, all level 16 elites. Final boss Hailar the Frigid |

sections.heading: Group notes
sections.markdown: - **Tank level:** tankable at about 30 with a decent shield, with "only a few sketchy moments with zuluhed" sailorVEVO · 2025-12-12. Do RFK first for the Marbled Buckler billienomates · 2025-12-12. Another player warns that leveling tanks get rolled unless they go in at about 32 Mima · 2026-01-11. - **Pet tanks work.** A level-32 BM hunter with a gorilla tanked through the dragon boss with a 34 druid healer and sub-30 DPS, with zero wipes Vic · 2025-09-26 (single source). Another hunter pet-tanked several bosses, using Aspect of the Monkey plus Disengage and Deterrence Dinousek · 2026-03-09. - **Difficulty:** "Unknown to many, and those who know it, know it's easy to wipe" Catyngla · 2025-10-28. Some players found it too easy Voodoo · 2025-11-24.

pages.title: Windhorn Canyon
pages.intro:
Turtle-custom level 26-30 5-man in Thousand Needles, added in 1.18.1. The Grimtotem have driven the Windhorn tauren out of the canyon. Staff billed it as "one challenging dungeon" ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)), and early players agree.

| | |
|---|---|
| Level / size | 26-30 (staff, wiki); 25-33 (LFT), 5 players |
| Location | Thousand Needles. The new Horde hub Sagh's Refuge sits in the canyon |
| Added | 1.18.1 (opened 2026-03-20) |
| Entry | None found |
| Bosses | 7. Final boss Chieftain Shalk Blackwind ([wiki](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Windhorn_Canyon)) |

sections.heading: Group notes
sections.markdown: - **Hard at its level.** "At its intended level Windhorn is pretty hard, there's so many packs and some mobs even got either knockbacks or summons" HighZet · 2026-03-22. One priest healer's group took 3 hours "and very precise CC" Molly · 2026-03-21. Bring CC and plan for a long run.

sections.heading: Loot and leveling value
sections.markdown: - **Engryss's two-hand mace** (Thornroot Maul): "better than Ravager" billienomates · 2025-11-03, "absolutely goated" Holidae · 2026-03-03. The official difficulty is "Uldaman" with a 2-hour clear, the longest of any custom 5-man. The dungeon has two halves, Castle and Descent, and 12 bosses. sections.heading: Group notes
sections.markdown: - **Level:** a 34 with about 2k HP can do part of it. 36+ is recommended for a full clear Seli · 2025-10-12, billienomates · 2025-10-12. - **Blind corners.** Many pulls hide casters and elementals that you cannot see until you pull Holidae · 2025-11-12, billienomates · 2025-11-12. Enemies can hit you through walls or around corners, for example casters' Rain of Fire. It is unclear whether that is a LoS bug billienomates · 2025-11-12. - **Cleansing:** lots of disease and poison trash, so bring Poison or Disease Cleansing Totem or other cleanses billienomates · 2025-10-14. - **Quests:** do the mail-helm chain (about 4 quests killing orcs) early, so group members do not compete for the drop later billienomates · 2025-10-12. - **Big pulls:** at 60, mages use it for 40-60-mob duo AoE pulls with the ZG Flarecore set Luden TA · 2026-02-04.

sections.heading: Loot and leveling value
sections.markdown: - **Totem of the Tides** (shaman relic): Water Shield deals AoE frost damage whenever you are hit. It is "op as fuck for leveling" Not Normal · 2026-03-23 and a big AoE-tank upgrade Frenchie · 2025-10-26. One shaman got it at level 33 on a first run, along with the Kelpie's Legacy shield Dinousek · 2025-10-18. It also speeds up Dire Maul lasher farming: one Fire Nova plus one Magma per pack instead of three totem casts Axemehowirol · 2025-08-16. - **Caster set:** 2 pieces of a new elemental caster set with a 1% spell-hit bonus Axemehowirol · 2025-08-16. The set drops here UncleBruce · 2025-10-05. The **Blackfire Orb** trinket comes from a related quest; it is not called "Orb of Kaladoon" Shared · 2025-10-08, Shared · 2025-10-08.

sections.heading: Solo farming
sections.markdown: - **Totem of the Tides farm at 60:** with the key you can enter through the back and fight only 4-5 packs to reach Stormsong Holidae · 2025-12-01. Without the key, go up the right-side wooden palisade to the roof and run past almost everything Axemehowirol · 2025-08-16. A level-60 shaman in a lasher-farm fire-totem tank build soloed up to him Storytown · 2025-10-03. - **Chieftain Stormsong solo:** doable with decent gear. At 48, skipping the trash may be tight billienomates · 2025-12-03.

sections.heading: Group notes
sections.markdown: - **Tanks: wear a shield.** "In Gilneas the elites and knights at the end of the instance will chunk you if you have 2-3 on you at once. Putting on a shield will make the healer a lot happier" Campsie/Lanik · 2025-03-06. Another tank preferred being Prot-specced with a shield there Andrew · 2025-04-01. - **Bring CC.** A level-49 deep-Prot tank in full Steel Plate found LFG runs "taxing on the healers" when the group had no CC. sections.heading: Solo farming at 60
sections.markdown: - **Rogue:** vampirism gear plus a Riposte/Assassination build solos the whole route. The loop is the last boss, the Overseer and the gnome, then out and repeat, for about 5 Fashion Coins and 40-60 g/h Allie :3 · 2026-04-03. Another player made at least 100 g/h on Nordanaar doing only last-boss runs; Ambershire rates are lower GumGuzz · 2026-04-03, Nandieb · 2026-04-03. The Onyxia "Dragonslayer" buff plus Enchanting is the suggested setup GumGuzz · 2026-03-29. Killing the bosses also gives weekly-quest crests Allie :3 · 2026-04-03. - **Priest:** soloable by a well-geared Disc or Smite priest; "a hard gear check" Greendam · 2025-10-05. One priest did it at 5.6k HP / 7k mana with SP and Stamina consumables. sections.markdown: The rework has 7 bosses ([Torta (staff), 2023-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=32868#p32868)). The sources name 7: **Chronar**, **Drifting Avatar of Time**, **Epidamu**, **Rotmaw** (crocolisk), **Mossheart** (bog beast), **Epochronos** and **Antnormi** (final boss) Droopystaff · 2025-03-25. Only Chronar (first) and Antnormi (last) have a known position. ### Chronar (first boss) - "Chronar's first boss, just gotta get passed a few hard packs" Drekalo, the Bringer of Light · 2025-02-22. The Black Morass polearm quest sends you to kill him. It rewards the Halberd of the Bronze Defender Drekalo, the Bringer of Light · 2025-02-22, WyFyL · 2024-12-04. - **He is not immune to slows.** With slows up he is "mega easy". He has a 1-minute Piercing Howl, so carry a PvP trinket WyFyL · 2024-12-04 (single source). - **Spell reflect.** The tell is a sparkle animation on the boss, not a yell. He also casts an AoE slowing shout that can leave a Felhunter out of range, so keep the pet close L-star · 2025-11-27, L-star · 2025-11-28. Warlocks use the Felhunter here Tatica ツ · 2025-03-20. - Loot: Monolith Headguard (a tank helm) Da Chilla Milla · 2025-01-12. ### The first big dragon boss, phase 2 - In phase 2 of "the first big dragon boss", it summons an add (an echo of a past figure, e.g. "the Lich King") that casts Mortal Coil and a fire AoE. **Hex it** while it is still weak. When the Hex wears off it is almost dead Akos · 2024-12-17 (single source, 2024-12). The source does not say which boss this is. ### Rotmaw, Mossheart, Epidamu, Drifting Avatar of Time - **Rotmaw** (the crocolisk boss) "consumes" the tank, and threat has to be retaken afterwards. That makes it rough for a tank with no taunt, such as a warlock tank Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-06-04 (single source). He drops the Idol of Savagery (the cat bleed idol) and Wraps of the Transmogrified ([Torta (staff), 2023-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=32868#p32868)), NazzyDragon · 2025-04-29, plus Rotmaw's Tooth, a common tanking dagger Aubreykun · 2023-12-27. - **Mossheart** drops Mossheart's Heart, a tank trinket (145 armor, 8 HP5, nature thorns) Mima · 2025-12-13. - **Epidamu** drops Totem of the Flowing Timeways and Fabric of Time ([Torta (staff), 2023-01-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=32868#p32868)), and the shaman Totem of the Calming River Takatunda · 2024-05-28. - **Drifting Avatar of Sand** (a related creature) cannot be stunned or frozen ([Torta (staff), 2023-10-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=69006#p69006)). pages.title: Other vanilla dungeons
pages.intro: Short notes for vanilla dungeons where the Turtle sources say little: Ragefire Chasm, the Stockade, Gnomeregan and Uldaman. Unless noted, these play as in vanilla. The Turtle-extended vanilla dungeons have their own pages: [Deadmines](#/instances/deadmines), [Wailing Caverns](#/instances/wailing-caverns), [Shadowfang Keep](#/instances/shadowfang-keep), [Blackfathom Deeps](#/instances/blackfathom-deeps), [Razorfen Kraul](#/instances/razorfen-kraul), [Scarlet Monastery](#/instances/scarlet-monastery), [Razorfen Downs](#/instances/razorfen-downs), [Zul'Farrak](#/instances/zulfarrak), [Maraudon](#/instances/maraudon), [Sunken Temple](#/instances/sunken-temple), [Blackrock Depths](#/instances/blackrock-depths), [Lower](#/instances/lower-blackrock-spire) and [Upper Blackrock Spire](#/instances/upper-blackrock-spire), [Dire Maul](#/instances/dire-maul), [Scholomance](#/instances/scholomance), [Stratholme](#/instances/stratholme). **Server-wide rules:** standard dungeon trash respawns in 5 hours ([Torta (staff), 2023-12-05](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=79953#p79953)). The 5-instances-per-hour limit is counted separately for dungeons and raids ([Torta (staff), 2025-04-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=128053#p128053)). Dungeon weekly quests were added in 1.18.0 and reset with the weekly maintenance ([Jamey (staff), 2025-09-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=151050#p151050)). The earliest dungeons open at about level 13 gray · 2026-04-04.

sections.heading: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
sections.markdown: The sources contain no group tactics. Solo notes follow. - **Paladin solo Emperor farm:** jump from the balcony and **keep running past Lord Incendius**, or the upstairs mobs follow you. Make the lava jump as soon as possible. In the throne room: Holy Shield → Consecration in melee range of the casters → wait for the first burst → Holy Shock → Crusader Strike → wait for the second burst → Holy Shock → finish the mobs Ruth · 2025-04-02 (video linked in the source). - **The Senators' alpha strike:** they cast 3 times in a row. **Line of sight all 3 casts** and they do nothing afterwards. Magic (frost) damage is the worst part of the pulls. Before T3, a solo is only worth it if you really want Ironfoe Silverhand · 2026-02-24, Silverhand · 2026-02-24, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2026-02-24, Silverhand · 2026-02-24. - **Rogue:** raid-geared rogues solo the torches, the golem, the throne room and the Emperor using target dummies. sections.heading: East (DME): lashers and the jump run
sections.markdown: ### Bosses on the farm route - **Hydrospawn** (water elemental, same area as the lashers): soloable by geared priests, paladins and others. Kite him around a pillar with Frost Aura up, or pull him to a wall and burn him YN · 2025-10-28, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2025-10-14, dusty (Make Shock Live Again) · 2025-10-14. He drops a blue to disenchant and a chance at a book. An invisible demon add sometimes drops Felcloth Lazepally · 2025-12-26. - **Zevrim Thornhoof** (satyr) sacrifices a player. **Shaman:** re-drop Grounding Totem immediately after it is consumed, and pre-place it Zaaparou · 2025-11-04, Zaaparou · 2025-11-04. **Rogue:** kick to interrupt his Sacrifice Kananaios · 2026-04-04. **Warlock:** go Demonology and use an enslaved rogue biloen · 2025-12-31. The old pathing-glitch kite is fixed biloen · 2025-12-31. - **The satyr boss upstairs:** pull him downstairs to the pillar. He cannot fit through the gap, so peek out, get one auto-attack plus Judgement, Exorcism or Crusader Strike, and step back into the gap Beldrin · 2025-10-14, Beldrin · 2025-10-14. - **Alzzin the Wildshaper (last boss):** he burns mana on hit, so a duo prefers a druid tank + shaman healer over a shaman tank. You can also kite him on the ledge Jorrick/Drath · 2025-10-20, Cariad · 2025-10-20. - **Full "jump run" order:** lashers → elemental boss → satyr boss upstairs → last boss Beldrin · 2025-10-14. Doable from level 50 YN · 2025-10-28. Two packs at a time in basic gear, then Hydrospawn and reset Snackz · 2026-02-26. sections.markdown: - **King Gordok charges.** That is intended, and it happened on official servers too. Hunters: do not have Serpent Sting on him when you Feign Death, since the tick pulls him back. Skip packs with pet pulls Elmgren · 2025-11-20, Elmgren · 2025-11-20. pages.title: Molten Core (MC)
pages.intro: **Summary:** The vanilla Tier 1 raid, 40 players, reworked by Turtle. Patch 1.18.0 added two areas (Incindis' Lair, Old Shadowforge) and three new encounters (**Incindis**, the golem pair **Basalthar & Smoldaris**, **Sorcerer-Thane Thaurissan**), removed Gehennas, and changed every old boss. It launched badly overtuned and was toned down during 2025. Now full green-geared groups clear it on Nordanaar Epickalen · 2026-01-22. Most of the raid needs **no Fire Resistance**. Only Ragnaros' and Baron Geddon's tanks do, plus potions on Magmadar, Majordomo and Geddon. Ragnaros, Geddon and the fire-elemental trash are **fire-immune**. Many mobs are **nature- and poison-immune**, so hunters and rogues swap tools almost every pull. | | | |---|---| | Type / size | Raid, 40 players, Tier 1 ([wiki](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Custom_Turtle_WoW_content)) | | Level | 60 | | Location | Blackrock Depths, Blackrock Mountain (vanilla entrance) | | Attunement | Vanilla "Attunement to the Core" (Lothos Riftwalker); quest access fixed 2026-03-21 ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608)) | | Turtle changes | 1.18.0 extension: Incindis' Lair and Old Shadowforge, 3 new encounters, 15+ items, **Gehennas removed** (his tier loot and rune moved to Incindis) ([Torta (staff), 2025-02-22](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120615#p120615)). pages.title: Blackwing Lair (BWL)

pages.intro: **Summary:** The vanilla Tier 2.5 raid, 40 players, with no new Turtle bosses. pages.title: Naxxramas
pages.intro: **Summary:** The vanilla Tier 3 raid, 40 players, 15 bosses, with no new Turtle bosses but several Turtle-specific quirks. Sapphiron's frost aura is bugged, so most raids skip Frost Resistance gear. Faerlina's room trash is linked to her and ignores the classic corner pull. Greater demons lose their path on the Thaddius jump. Every boss can bleed, and in practice no boss is immune to poisons. Veterans call it "easy but kinda long" 30 · 2026-01-11. The roadblocks are Patchwerk, Heigan, the Four Horsemen and Kel'Thuzad, and gear matters most on Patchwerk Virasan · 2025-12-13, Virasan · 2025-12-13. | | | |---|---| | Type / size | Raid, 40 players, Tier 3 | | Level | 60 | | Location | Floating above Stratholme, Eastern Plaguelands (vanilla entrance) | | Turtle changes | No new bosses. Kel'Thuzad ring tokens (2024-11-09) ([Jamey (staff), 2024-11-09](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=107253#p107253)); Plagued Riding Spider mount from Kel'Thuzad; Heigan safe spot removed ([Torta (staff), 2025-08-26](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=148454#p148454)); Grobbulus' Poison Cloud no longer hits far-away players ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=171608#p171608)). sections.heading: Raid-wide preparation
sections.markdown: - **Bleeds:** all Naxx bosses can bleed drago · 2026-01-16, Medvedev · 2026-01-16. - **Poisons:** no Naxx boss is poison-immune Rheinwg · 2025-08-22. Only Skeletons and Wraiths/Ghosts among the trash resist Nature poisons; Dissolvent/Corrosive work on undead Lightemgee · 2025-12-05, Lightemgee · 2025-12-05. Rheinwg's plan: Instant is the safest trash poison (scattered humanoids and beasts); Faerlina, Maexxna and Gothik are the special cases, and Gothik is Dissolvent-only; simplified call: Instant + Deadly 5/4 in the Spider Wing, Dissolvent + Deadly/Corrosive elsewhere Rheinwg · 2026-03-21. - **Undead:** switch to Consecrated Sharpening Stones or Blessed Wizard Oil after the Spider Wing PHPROmega · 2026-02-14, angels1m · 2026-01-19. - **Resistance potions** (tank view) 30 · 2026-01-11: Shadow for the Four Horsemen and Loatheb; Frost for Sapphiron and Kel'Thuzad; most other bosses need none (Anub'Rekhan's nature damage only matters for the off-tank holding the add stack; Heigan's is avoidable). Greater Fire and Greater Nature Protection do not overwrite each other, so stack both on Faerlina 30 · 2026-01-11, Black Hat · 2026-01-11. - **Frost Resistance is not needed for Sapphiron** on Turtle: the aura ticks irregularly (every 2-4 s) and even during the air phase, so raids use Frost Protection Potions instead; for tanks FR gear only prolongs the fight Squid · 2025-11-12, MoneyCow(ruin my own fun) · 2025-11-16, Velanir · 2025-11-16, Kyrsie · 2025-12-13. Most fights are "paper threat"; only Sapphiron and Thaddius really test the tank tripleXDengine · 2026-02-03. Mitigation gear on Maexxna and Patchwerk (if not MT), Sapphiron; threat gear elsewhere Aladar · 2026-03-04, Lans · 2025-12-28. Bring Greater Stoneshield potions for the Four Horsemen tanks Coldmountain(hoj is hecked) · 2025-03-30. Flasks are treated as mandatory in progression Kyrsie · 2026-01-29. - **Healers:** a high-output tank survives on proactive healing and coordination (pre-pull armor buffs), not healer count; one guild kept its Sapphiron tank up with 2 dedicated paladins 30 · 2026-02-18, 30 · 2026-02-18. - **Pets:** Naxx is easy on pets except when they over-aggro RioJnfer · 2026-03-24. pages.intro: **Summary:** A custom 10-player raid in the lower floors of Karazhan, Deadwind Pass, aimed at Molten Core difficulty. Its layout follows TBC's lower Karazhan up to the Opera, with all-custom bosses Shardphoenix · 2026-04-09. sections.heading: Boss order
sections.markdown: Four bosses — **Brood Queen Araxxna** (spider), **Grizikil** (imps), **Clawlord Howlfang** (worgen) and **Lord Blackwald II** (after the Dark Rider Champion) — can be done in any order; **Moroes** on the opera stage is last; **Master Blacksmith Rolfen** is optional ([Speedz1337 (guide writer), 2025-11-19](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=160087#p160087)).

sections.heading: Raid-wide preparation
sections.markdown: - **Decurse** the tanks: a missing mage or druid decurser means heavy damage from stacking curses Virasan · 2026-01-22, Grey · 2025-12-11. - **Poison:** every group wants a shaman for the spider basement peter_hammer · 2025-10-19. - Only Howlfang, the Ghost Knights and Moroes hit hard Kyrsie · 2026-01-22. A shaman makes a good off-tank here thanks to Chain Lightning-pull AoE threat Zaaparou · 2024-11-28.

sections.heading: Bosses

Bears can let a DPS soak the early stacks in a corner and take over around 10 Micro Jackson · 2025-11-20. Solo tanking is possible with plenty of HP and avoidance, strong DPS and alert healers; a warlock solo-tanked him repeatedly Tephus · 2025-11-20, ThatsTheJoke · 2026-02-22, Summonjutsu - GL <Tremor Totems> · 2025-07-31. pages.title: Emerald Sanctum (ES)
pages.intro: **Summary:** A custom 40-player raid in Hyjal at "Blackwing Lair difficulty" (Tier 2), with two bosses: **Erennius** (mini-boss) and **Solnius the Awakener**. In **normal mode** you kill Erennius first. In **hard mode** you fight Solnius while Erennius stays alive and has to be tanked. The raid is a sleep, dispel and resistance puzzle. Solnius and his trash resist Nature and poisons. Hard mode punishes wrong dispels. The add phase is random and gets much harder with Scalebanes. sections.heading: Raid-wide preparation
sections.markdown: - **Nature and poisons:** Solnius has 50 Nature and 100 Shadow resistance ([Borefficz (player), 2024-05-14](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=94829#p94829)), Arcomage · 2024-11-27, and is "super resistant to poisons" Scruff · 2024-11-06; Instant Poison works on ES mobs, with resists Oshy · 2026-03-24, Dimbei · 2026-03-24. Solnius is nature/poison-immune enough that Corrosive Poison was added for rogues ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-10-12](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=102971#p102971)). - **Mana:** Solnius is a mana-drain fight, like Kel'Thuzad Arcomage · 2024-12-13. - **Sleeps:** sleep-heavy trash gets dispelled by healers, which cancels a boomkin's Hurricane and wastes its cooldown Voodoo · 2026-03-13, Voodoo · 2026-03-16. Erennius' **Dreamstate** is a dispellable Magic sleep ([Torta (staff), 2023-12-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=82980#p82980)). - **Tank gear:** a Nature Resistance set for hard-mode Erennius is on one tank's list of sets Grey · 2025-12-19.

sections.heading: Quests: the douse chain
sections.markdown: From an NPC in the bear cave above the raid entrance, at Timbermaw **honored**: (1) kill the first boss; (2) kill the shamans in the raid for totems; (3) kill three outdoor elites (Un'Goro, Feralas, Alcaz Island; 120-220k HP, ~30 min respawn); (4) take a pouch from behind the Archdruid and a flower from behind the nature boss Alexander · 2026-03-28, Jesse Potter · 2026-03-28. The quests are worth ~3-4k reputation plus ~3k from clearing Jesse Potter · 2026-03-29. A harder "Eternal Douse" (exalted, 7-day lockout) follows the final boss (single source in the reader notes).

sections.heading: Gaps
sections.markdown:
- Boss order and the mapping of player nicknames to boss names are uncertain.
- The Kronn, Selenaxx and Loktanag fights are barely described.
- The raid was live for under two months before the server-closure announcement, so tactics are first-week reports.

pages.title: Tower of Karazhan ("Kara40", "K40", Upper Karazhan)
pages.intro: **Summary:** Turtle's hardest raid (Tier 3.5). An experienced tank's view: "not that much of a step up from Naxx", but every raider must execute mechanics, and small mistakes wipe the raid (one player moving during a 6-second window on the last boss) Grey · 2026-01-06, Grey · 2026-01-06. 40 players, 9 encounters. Plan on Naxxramas-level gear, **7-11 healers**, about **200 Arcane Resistance** for Anomalus, a **Shadow Resistance tank** for the Chess Bishop, **2-3 players per magic school** for Incantagos, and spell penetration or a spec swap for Mephistroth. Most bosses are demons (bring Elixir of Demonslaying). About half the bosses are **bleed-immune** and several are immune to specific poisons or schools, so check the immunity table before you pick a spec. The trash kills more raids than some of the bosses. | | | |---|---| | Type / size | Raid, 40 players; Tier 3.5, "gameplay even more difficult than Naxxramas" ([Torta (staff), 2023-12-28](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=82980#p82980); [turtlecraft.gg, Raids and Dungeons](https://turtlecraft.gg/raids-and-dungeons)) | | Level | 60 ([wiki](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Tower_of_Karazhan)) | | Location | Deadwind Pass, Karazhan tower (above Lower Karazhan Halls) | | Patch / opened | 1.17.2; opened 2025-04-03 13:00 UTC ([Torta (staff), 2025-02-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=120590#p120590)) | | Attunement | **Upper Karazhan Tower Key** (The Key to Karazhan I-X, starts inside Lower Karazhan Halls) opens the first five bosses; **the Scepter of Medivh** opens the last four ([wiki](https://turtle-wow.fandom.com/wiki/Tower_of_Karazhan_attunement)). sections.heading: Boss order
sections.markdown: Keeper Gnarlmoon → Ley-Watcher Incantagos → Anomalus → Echo of Medivh → Chess Event → Sanv Tas'dal → Rupturan the Broken → Kruul → Mephistroth Gilnean · 2026-01-25, Thirtyseven · 2025-12-08. Bosses 6-9 are the "Outland bosses" behind the Scepter ([Torta (staff), 2025-04-16](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=126946#p126946)). One guild's kill times: Gnarlmoon ~3 min, Incantagos ~2, Anomalus ~1.5, Medivh ~1, Chess 2:30-3, Sanv 2:30-3, Rupturan ~3, Kruul 2-2:30, Mephistroth 3-5 depending on phase RNG tripleXDengine · 2025-10-26 (single source).

pages.title: World bosses and open-world raid encounters
pages.intro: **Summary:** Turtle keeps the vanilla world bosses (Azuregos, Kazzak, the four Nightmare Dragons) and adds its own, such as Dark Reaver of Karazhan, Nerubian Overseer, Ostarius, Concavius, Cla'ckora and Father Lycan. Since 1.18.1 most can be **summoned** with artifacts from raids plus materials, and you can loot each boss **once per week per character**. The Discord sources contain very few tactics for them. This page collects the resistances, loot and the few fight notes that exist, plus the open-world raid-strength quest bosses (the White Stag, Bovar'kez).

sections.heading: Summoning and loot rules
sections.markdown: - 1.18.1: "Powerful artifacts hidden within raid dungeons, combined with materials found throughout the world, allow summoning a specific World Boss" ([Torta (staff), 2025-10-03](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=154168#p154168)). - "Everyone can summon and kill world bosses multiple times per week, but you are eligible for loot on the first kill of a world boss every week on that character" ([Dragunovi (staff), 2024-12-04](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=111212#p111212)). - Summoned corpses despawn after 30 minutes; summoned bosses no longer have proximity aggro ([Torta (staff), 2026-03-24](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=172139#p172139), [Torta (staff), 2026-04-21](https://forum.turtlecraft.gg/viewtopic.php?p=176101#p176101)). - Known summon sources from players: an item from Majordomo (MC) summoned a boss in the Blasted Lands; the Nerubian Overseer summon drops in Naxx; Kara10 drops the Dark Reaver summon Athurian · 2026-03-22, Athurian · 2026-03-22, Athurian · 2026-03-22.
